# Vendored packages

`gatsby-gravityforms-component-3.1.1.tgz` is kept here because the package was unpublished from npm on 2025-12-20, so it can no longer be installed from the registry.

This is the original published tarball, recovered from registry.npmmirror.com. Its SHA-512 matches the integrity value that was already in `package-lock.json`, and npm checks that hash on every install. Please don't delete or repack it.
